selected_script.angle: Stop wiping greasy microwave door film with a damp paper towel because it leaves oily streaks and lint; use foaming degreaser on the same spot, then wipe to a clear finish
selected_script.hook: I kept wiping this microwave grease with a damp paper towel, and it just turned into streaks.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up on a greasy stainless microwave or oven door edge with brown cooking splatter and fingerprint haze. A hand uses a damp white paper towel in small circles, but the grease visibly smears into cloudy streaks instead of lifting.
timeline.3-6s: The same hand keeps pressing harder with the damp paper towel on the same area. The towel leaves lint bits and a wider oily rainbow residue, with a small frustrated pause as the camera stays close enough to show the streaking.
timeline.6-10s: EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser enters naturally from the kitchen counter. The recognizable white trigger bottle with orange label, dark navy footer, EcoPure Lab logo, Heavy Duty Degreaser title, Foaming Action cue, and 300 ml compact shape is shown in-hand, then sprayed lightly onto the same greasy section. Foam clings briefly, a gray cloth wipes through it, and the camera holds a comparable close angle showing the cleaned patch beside the still-streaky edge for credible before-after proof. Voiceover ends lightly: 'That was way easier. Try it on the greasy spots you keep re-wiping.'

script_record.voiceover: I kept wiping this microwave grease with a damp paper towel, and it just turned into streaks. Then I switched to EcoPure Lab. A little foam, one wipe, and you can actually see the difference. Try it on the greasy spots you keep re-wiping.
script_record.product_consistency_rules: Preserve the EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser identity exactly: white molded plastic trigger spray bottle, short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white screw collar, molded side finger grooves, rounded rectangular lower body, glossy orange front label over dark navy bottom band, EcoPure Lab logo near the upper label, large Heavy Duty Degreaser wording, Foaming Action subtitle, small stovetop image panel, and 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml capacity cue. Do not change label color, bottle shape, nozzle style, proportions, material, or brand.

scenes.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a normal American kitchen with natural light, no platform UI. Use one continuous internal timeline in a single video. 0-3s: start with an extreme close-up of a greasy stainless microwave or oven door edge, showing brown cooking splatter, fingerprint haze, and dull oily film. A real hand tries the familiar ordinary method: wiping with a damp white paper towel in small circles. The method visibly fails; the grease smears into cloudy streaks instead of lifting. 3-6s: continue the same failed damp paper towel method on the exact same area. The hand presses harder and wipes again, making the oily rainbow residue wider and leaving a few realistic lint bits. Show effort and mild frustration through a brief pause and tighter handheld close-up, but keep it natural and safe. 6-10s: the EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser enters naturally from the nearby kitchen counter in the same shot environment. Preserve product identity from the reference image exactly: white molded plastic trigger spray bottle, short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white screw collar, molded side finger grooves, rounded rectangular 300 ml bottle body, glossy orange front label with dark navy bottom band, EcoPure Lab logo near the upper label, large Heavy Duty Degreaser title, Foaming Action subtitle, small stovetop grease image panel, and 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml capacity cue. A hand sprays a light, realistic layer of white foam onto the same greasy section; foam clings briefly without dramatic smoke or exaggerated chemical reaction. A gray cleaning cloth wipes through the foam in one or two practical passes. Finish on a stable comparable close angle showing a clearly cleaner patch beside a still-streaky edge for credible before-after contrast, then the bottle sits nearby with label visible. Include natural conversational voiceover only: 'I kept wiping this microwave grease with a damp paper towel, and it just turned into streaks. Then I switched to EcoPure Lab. A little foam, one wipe, and you can actually see the difference. Try it on the greasy spots you keep re-wiping.' Forbid subtitles, text overlays, stickers, watermarks, floating icons, poster banners, before-after graphic split screens, invented accessories, product color or label drift, magical cleanup, exaggerated foam floods, disinfectant or bacteria-killing claims, and unreadable promotional callouts.
